set.body:
Scope
Give competing approaches the same registration, supervision, and evaluation opportunity.

Acceptance criteria
- Frozen registered density, MultiMatch dimensions, and contraction-aware elastic matching are included where dependencies permit.
- A nested-CV ridge or ranking composite of MultiMatch dimensions is implemented as the strong predictive MultiMatch baseline.
- A comparably supervised multiscale-density model is included.
- Frozen-metric and supervised/calibrated courts are reported separately.
- All methods use identical outer folds, candidate sets, warp policy, priors, and scoring metrics.
- Hyperparameter training and preprocessing are confined to inner folds.
- Missing optional dependencies produce explicit skips rather than silent comparator removal.
- Baseline outputs retain their native diagnostics so predictive strength is not confused with interpretive dimensionality.
set.title: GW-5 Build the fair comparator suite
